FX-GPG-001.says: The settings as they start: black stretch 1, every gamma and gain 1, every pedestal 0, so the drawing, untouched.

FX-GPG-002.says: Black stretch 2: every dark value lifted, the warm shadow and the dim rows most; black and full values stay.

FX-GPG-003.says: Black stretch 4, as far as it goes: the darks lifted much more.

FX-GPG-004.says: Red gamma 2: the middle of the red channel brighter, so the skin, grey and warm tones go redder; green and blue untouched, and 0 and full red stay.

FX-GPG-005.says: Every gamma 0.5: the middle of every channel darker, the colours deeper.

FX-GPG-006.says: Every pedestal 0.2: black becomes a grey of 0.2 (about 51 of 255), white stays white, everything between lifted a little less the brighter it is.

FX-GPG-007.says: Every gain 0.5: white becomes a grey of 0.5, black stays black, everything halved in its encoded values.

FX-GPG-008.says: Every pedestal and gain 0.5: every colour the same grey of 0.5, the covering kept.

FX-GPG-009.says: Every pedestal 1 and gain 0: the channel turned over, so the drawing's negative: black white, red cyan, yellow blue.

FX-GPG-010.says: Every pedestal -0.5: the lower half of each channel held at 0, the rest stretched down to it; white stays white.

FX-GPG-011.says: Every gain 2: each channel doubled, everything above half held at full.

FX-GPG-012.says: Black stretch 1.5, red gain 1.2, green pedestal 0.1 and blue gamma 1.5 together, each channel its own curve.

FX-GPG-013.says: Red gain keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 the red channel halved, frame 4 no red at all.

FX-GPG-014.says: FX-GPG-012 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-GPG-015.says: Black stretch 0.9, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GPG-016.says: Black stretch 4.1, above 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GPG-017.says: Green gamma 0.09, below 0.1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GPG-018.says: Blue gamma 10.1, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GPG-019.says: Red pedestal 1.1, above 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GPG-020.says: Green gain -0.1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GPG-021.says: Blue gain 4.1, above 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
